description: This PHP source file contains a PHPUnit test class 'DetailedLeaveRequestTest' for testing the 'DetailedLeaveRequest' Data Transfer Object (DTO) within the OrangeHRM leave plugin module. It includes setup methods and multiple test cases that evaluate behaviors such as leave request details, handling of holidays and multiple statuses, and fetching leave periods under specific conditions.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of DetailedLeaveRequest DTO, including leave detail calculations and period fetching under various scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data using a YAML fixture before each test execution.

methods.name: testEmptyLeaveRequest
methods.description: Tests handling of an empty leave request, particularly uninitialized properties and empty leaves.

methods.name: testSingleDayLeaveRequest
methods.description: Verifies details of a single-day leave request, including dates and duration type.

methods.name: testMultiDayLeaveRequestFirstDayHoliday
methods.description: Checks the allowed actions for a multi-day leave request where the first day falls on a holiday.

methods.name: testMultiStatusLeaveRequest
methods.description: Validates the allowed actions for a leave request with multiple statuses.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Configures mocked user and other service dependencies for testing.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodsWithAssignedLeaveForPastLeavePeriod
methods.description: Tests fetching leave periods with assigned leave, ensuring correct behavior for past leave periods based on current date.
